errors.message: Allocation by WEIGHT is not permitted. The approved method is PURCHASE_VALUE_PROPORTION.
Unknown allocation method "MAGIC". Only PURCHASE_VALUE_PROPORTION is approved.
Project transportation (warehouse -> site) must never be allocated into landed cost. It is a separate project cost head.
Batch line "(no id)" needs a componentId, a positive quantity and a purchaseUnitPrice.
Batch line "a" needs a componentId, a positive quantity and a purchaseUnitPrice.
Batch line "b" needs a componentId, a positive quantity and a purchaseUnitPrice.
Batch line "c" needs a componentId, a positive quantity and a purchaseUnitPrice.
A delivery charge cannot be allocated by purchase value when the batch purchase value is zero.
